item.title: Monica vs EspoCRM vs SuiteCRM: Best Self-Hosted CRM Platforms 2026
item.description: Managing customer relationships is the lifeblood of any business. While cloud-based CRM platforms like Salesforce, HubSpot, and Zoho dominate the market, self-hosted CRM solutions offer complete data ownership, zero subscription fees, and full customization — without handing your customer data to a third-party SaaS vendor.
